title: Che Ba Mau
description: Che Ba Mau is a dish from Vietnam prepared with mung beans, adzuki beans, tapioca pearls, coconut milk. This is a home-scale version with measured ingredients in the individual steps where they are used. The three-color dessert is an accessible approximation with available beans and tapioca, not a full traditional jelly selection.

steps.instruction: Soak the dried mung beans in clean water, discard the water and simmer separately in fresh water until fully soft.
Cook the listed ingredients in simmering water for about 45 minutes until tender; drain well if necessary.
Soak the adzuki beans for several hours; discard the soaking water before fully boiling until tender.
Cook the listed ingredients in simmering water for about 75 minutes until tender; drain well if necessary.
Cook the listed ingredients in simmering water for about 13 minutes until tender; drain well if necessary.
Combine the listed ingredients in a bowl until evenly mixed; avoid overworking delicate components.
Assemble the cooled components with the listed fillings or toppings. Refrigerate briefly if needed to set the layers.
